info.title: OpenAI-Compatible Image Generations
info.description: Standard OpenAI-compatible `POST /v1/images/generations` endpoint. As of July 28, 2026 it serves `seedream-5-0-260128`, `wan2.7-image`, `wan2.7-image-pro`, and `gpt-image-2`. The older `seedream-4-5-251128` is routed through [`/v1/chat/completions`](/api-reference/chat/post_chat-completions-image-generation) instead, and Gemini-compatible `generateContent` requests use [`/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent`](/api-reference/chat/post_models-model-generatecontent).

CostEstimate.description: Read-only cost quote for the exact request. No Provider call, billing reservation, durable job, or price lock is created.

currency.description: Quote currency. Always USD in this version.

estimate_kind.description: `exact` is a fully determined customer price; `upper_bound` has a locally enforceable ceiling in `max_cost_micros_usd`; `estimate` depends on terminal usage and may exceed the quoted amount.

estimated_cost_micros_usd.description: Quoted customer cost in micro-USD (1 USD = 1,000,000 micros).

max_cost_micros_usd.description: Optional hard customer-cost ceiling in micro-USD. Present for `exact` and `upper_bound`; omitted for `estimate`.

pricing_version.description: Optional immutable or compiled pricing version.

estimated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the quote was produced.

metadata.description: Bounded non-sensitive quote metadata, such as a canonical model or profile key.

XAISACostMode.name: X-AISA-Cost-Mode
XAISACostMode.description: Set to `quote` to estimate this exact request without executing data, creating a job, or authorizing spend. A successful quote is HTTP 200 with a `cost_estimate` body; it is not a reservation or price lock. Omit the header for normal execution. Any other value returns `400 invalid_cost_mode`. Quote mode requires an API key and cannot use MPP or x402.

CostEstimate.description: Read-only cost quote. The intended request is validated but not executed, billed, reserved, or locked.

Cache-Control.description: Quotes are never stored by shared caches.

Vary.description: Response body depends on the cost-mode header.

post.description:
Generate images with the OpenAI-compatible images-generations endpoint.

**Size constraint (Seedream routes only).** Seedream's upstream requires a minimum of **3,686,400 pixels** per image. Requests below that return `400 InvalidParameter: image size must be at least 3686400 pixels`. Wan and `gpt-image-2` routes accept smaller sizes — `1024x1024` is verified working for `wan2.7-image`.

model.description: Image generation model. `seedream-5-0-260128` ($0.035/request), `wan2.7-image` ($0.030/request), `wan2.7-image-pro` ($0.075/request), or `gpt-image-2` ($0.03/request or $0.05 per 1024×1024 image).

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

n.description: Number of images to generate. Each image is billed separately at the per-image rate.

size.description: Image dimensions as `WIDTHxHEIGHT`. Seedream routes require `width × height ≥ 3,686,400` (e.g. `1920x1920`, `2048x2048`); Wan and `gpt-image-2` accept smaller sizes such as `1024x1024`.

value.prompt: A cute red panda, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting
A futuristic cyberpunk city, neon lights, rainy night, 8k
Oil painting of a rolling hillside at sunset

200.description: Images generated successfully. When `X-AISA-Cost-Mode` is `quote`, HTTP 200 returns a `cost_estimate` instead of executing this operation. The quote is not a reservation, authorization, or price lock.

url.description: Short-lived URL to the generated image. Download and persist it; the URL expires.

size.description: Actual dimensions of the returned image.

400.description: Invalid request. Most common: `size` smaller than 3,686,400 pixels → `"image size must be at least 3686400 pixels"`.

401.description: Missing or invalid AIsa API key.

404.description: The model isn't routed through this endpoint. The gateway returns `model_route_not_supported` with the model's actual supported routes — see the [model catalog](/guides/models).
